title: studio → pipelines: a steer (or Stop) for the running assistant turn
description: From API 1.59 (board Assistant frame 8; contracts/README.md, Assistant: steer). Written by studio's outbox in the transaction that stores a message sent while the chat's turn works (POST …/messages answered `steer` true), or a `stop`; subject `cmd.assistant.steer` (stream CMD, durable `pipelines-assistant`), Nats-Msg-Id `<thread_id>:steer:<steer_id>` (a stop: `<thread_id>:stop:<turn>`). pipelines handles it at once, outside the chat's lock: the running turn reads it at its next step (before its next model call; a parked turn once its results come) and adds the text to the transcript as the user's words, in order, then publishes evt.assistant.steered; a stop ends the turn there (the calls not run yet do not run). One whose turn already ended is dropped: studio sends unread steers as the next message.

turn.description: the thread's input counter when it was sent: the running turn's (a steer is never read by a turn after it)

steer_id.description: the stored message's id (its entry key message:<steer_id>)

stop.description: Stop: end the turn at its next step
